summary: PowerShell code quality is solid (Set-StrictMode, error handling, parameter validation), but deliverable is fundamentally incomplete. Missing: tests/VersionBumper.Tests.ps1 (workflow references it), fixtures/commits.txt, initial VERSION file. Task explicitly requires red-green TDD methodology with Pester tests—none provided. Workflow would fail immediately on `act` due to missing files. Code itself is modular and well-commented, but absence of tests, fixtures, and end-to-end validation means the core requirements are unmet. The module functions (Get-CurrentVersion, Get-CommitBumpType, Get-NextVersion) are well-designed, but lack of test infrastructure prevents verification of correctness and makes future maintenance risky.
